The PTR060V0160-TR is a polymeric positive temperature coefficient (PPTC) resettable fuse manufactured by Eaton (Electronics Division / Bussmann)
• Max Operating Voltage: 60 VDC
• Hold Current (\(I_{h}\)): 1.6 A (at +23°C)
• Trip Current (\(I_{t}\)): 3.2 A
• Max Interrupt / Fault Current (\(I_{max}\)): 40 A
• Initial Resistance: ~90 mΩ to 140 mΩ (depending on spec sheet rating)
• Power Dissipation: 1.9 W
• Operating Temperature Range: -40°C to +85°C
• Lead Spacing: 0.197" (5.0 mm)
